rows.question: What is the minimum health insurance premium in Lausanne for an adult?
notes: Assumed an adult aged 30 (adult rate from age 26)
Assumed the 300 CHF franchise (deductible), the standard one; a higher franchise lowers the premium
rows.answer:
1. The minimum health insurance premium in Lausanne for an adult in 2026, WITHOUT accident cover, is 531.7 CHF per month (Sanitas, TelMed (Compact One)).
2. The minimum health insurance premium in Lausanne for an adult in 2026, WITH accident cover, is 570.1 CHF per month (Atupri, HMO).
3. To compare offers, you can visit the official website of the Swiss health insurance comparison (https://www.priminfo.admin.ch/de/praemien).

Practical next step: Compare these premiums on the official Swiss health insurance comparison website to find the best option for you.

rows.question: Quelle est la prime minimale d'assurance maladie à Lausanne pour un adulte ?
notes: Assumed an adult aged 30 (adult rate from age 26)

rows.answer:

2. Ces montants sont les plus bas que vous pouvez trouver pour un adulte de 30 ans avec une franchise de 300 CHF.

5. Si vous avez des questions supplémentaires, n'hésitez pas à me demander de l'aide.

rows.question: Je viens d'arriver d'Allemagne pour travailler, quel permis de séjour me faut-il ?
rows.answer:
1. Si vous êtes citoyen de l'UE ou de l'EEE et que vous prévoyez de travailler en Suisse, vous pouvez avoir besoin d'un permis de séjour B. 
2. Pour obtenir un permis de séjour B, vous devez généralement être enregistré auprès de la commune où vous résidez et répondre à certaines conditions.
3. Vous pouvez trouver plus d'informations sur le site de l'Office fédéral des migrations (SEM) ou auprès de votre commune.

Voici où vous pouvez comparer les offres de permis de séjour B :
https://www.sem.admin.ch/sem/en/home/themen/fza_schweiz-eu-efta/eu-efta_buerger_schweiz.html

Passez à la mairie ou à l'office du travail de votre commune pour en savoir plus.

rows.question: How many signatures does a federal popular initiative need?
rows.answer: A federal popular initiative requires 100,000 valid signatures to be valid. This rule is detailed in the Guide to the Federal Popular Initiative (Volksinitiative), published by the Federal Chancellery of Switzerland (Bundeskanzlei). The collection period for these signatures is 18 months. The source of this information is the website of the Federal Chancellery, as cited above.

rows.question: Chi può votare alle elezioni del Consiglio nazionale?
rows.answer: Il diritto di voto alle elezioni del Consiglio nazionale spetta ai cittadini svizzeri che abbiano compiuto il 18° anno di età. Questo diritto è regolato dal diritto federale. Le elezioni per il Consiglio degli Stati, invece, sono regolate dal diritto cantonale. La fonte ufficiale è il sito web della Segreteria di Stato per le questioni politiche (Bundesamt für Binnenhandel) in tedesco (https://www.bk.admin.ch/de/nationalratswahlen).

rows.question: Wie viel Mehrwertsteuer zahle ich auf ein Paket im Wert von 200 Franken aus dem Ausland?
notes: Dropped vat_rate '8.1%' after a tool error
rows.answer: Die gesetzliche Mehrwertsteuer (MWST) für ein Paket im Wert von 200 Franken aus dem Ausland beträgt 8,1%. Die geschätzte MWST beträgt 16,20 Franken. Bitte beachten Sie, dass eventuelle Zollgebühren, zusätzliche Steuern und Speditionsgebühren nicht in dieser Berechnung enthalten sind. Die Quelle ist das Bundesamt für Zoll und Grenzsicherheit (BAZG) auf www.bazg.admin.ch. (Mehrwertsteuergesetz in der Schweiz, Artikel 25)

rows.question: What is the current reference interest rate for rents?
rows.answer: As of the latest published data, the current reference interest rate for rents in Switzerland is 1.25%. This rate is set by the Federal Office of Housing (UFAB) and applies to all cantons for national rent adjustments. However, individual rent changes are based on the specific lease agreement. The next update is expected on December 1, 2026.

rows.question: Can I exchange my US driving licence in Zurich?
notes: Dropped fact_type 'exchange' (allowed: all, fee, deadline, requirement)
rows.answer:
1. **Commune**: A local government in Switzerland, like a city or town.
2. **Franchise**: The term you use to change your US driving licence in Zurich (not needed for us residents yet).
3. **Permit B**: A Swiss driving licence for professional use of categories D and DE (like buses and trucks), which you might need if you drive for work.

To compare offers for exchanging your US driving licence in Zurich, visit the official website of the Strassenverkehrsamt Kanton Zürich: https://www.zh.ch/de/mobilitaet/fuehrerausweis-fahren-lernen/auslaendischer-fuehrerausweis/auslaendischen-fuehrerausweis-umtauschen.html. This page will provide you with detailed information and application procedures.

Practical next step: Review the official website for the latest information on exchanging your driving licence, including requirements and deadlines.
